about: Extra groups for the live Discord demo. '@squad simulate' creates each as a channel, posts its seed messages, then live mode keeps the conversation going: the language model writes the next messages in character (or, with no model key, it picks from 'lines'). Personas get simple class schedules so the planner has real conflicts to work around.

Ava.vibe: organized floor RA type, plans everything, a little bossy

Marcus.vibe: gym and soccer guy, funny, always hungry

Lena.vibe: chill art major, sarcastic, night owl

Diego.vibe: soccer captain, bilingual, texts in spanish sometimes

Arjun.vibe: CS grad student, helpful, mixes hindi and english (hinglish)

Noah.vibe: busy grad student, works shifts, dry humor

Kavya.vibe: runs Indian Students Association events, energetic, uses some tamil words (tanglish)
